events.title: New Feature: Vaulting and Climbing!
events.summary: You can now vault over obstacles!Moving forward, new levels will be designed with vaulting in mind, allowing you to vault over certain obstacles, walls, and climb onto platforms.Not everything will be vaultable or climbable. It will be clear when these actions are available. events.title: Exposure and lighting fix
events.summary: Recent updates broke the lighting in some levels but is now fixed. After changing the lighting technology and removing Lumen, some levels became far too dark. This has now been reworked and should look much better.A setting was unintentionally overriding the exposure of the entire game. This issue has now been fixed.Overall lighting and visibility have been improved while keeping the atmosphere intact.

events.title: Steam Update - Major Bug Fix & Optimization

It was too demanding for lower-end hardware and for streamers. events.title: New Feature – Personality Trait Levels
events.summary: Some players felt confused or surprised by the results they received.Personality isn’t black and white, traits exist on a spectrum. Some individuals are more extroverted, more open, or more reactive than others.To make this clearer, I’ve added Personality Trait Levels (Low / Medium / High / Extreme) to better reflect how your answers shape your profile.Understanding yourself is a core part of the experience, and this change should help make those results feel more accurate and meaningful.
